result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the favorite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' list are styled inconsistently, and one card's image treatment differs from its siblings.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) uses a dark filled circle with a dark heart outline, whereas the card above (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) uses a white circle with a dark heart. The dark-on-dark version has very low contrast against the dark food photo and looks broken/unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button style (e.g., white/translucent circle with a dark heart, or dark circle with a white heart) across all restaurant cards and ensure sufficient contrast against the image background.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey image background while the neighbouring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image backgrounds/placeholders so all cards in the carousel share the same visual weight and treatment.
